newsitem.title: USA: US Plains fed cattle trade seen slowing - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains fed cattle trade seen slowing - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle sales were seen slowing into next week's holiday-shortened week, feedlot sources said.
Most plants will be closed Wednesday for Christmas and at least one beef plant will be closed for the week.
National Beef LP, a subsidiary of Farmland Foods Inc will close its cattle slaughter and beef processing plant at Liberal, Kan., for maintenance.
Sales Thursday were light at $65.00 per cwt, with most of this week's cattle sold by Wednesday. Some packers requested two-day pickups to ensure quick, full inventory, sources said.
